name: Haruna Tomomi
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c13950]Kurumi's[/url] classmate and best friend. She has a crush on [url=http://vndb.org/c13945]Akira[/url] and is very open about it. She sneaks in to a meeting between [url=http://vndb.org/c13953]Kurura[/url] and the magical girls and learns their secret. Her alternate reality self is also good friends with [url=http://vndb.org/c13947]Miruku[/url] and the others but isn't a magical girl there either.

She loves cosplay.
